name: Sling
summary: Sling has a free plan for up to 30 users that covers shift scheduling, and its paid plans cost $1.70 (Premium) or $3.40 (Business) per user a month on annual billing. Shift swaps and unavailability tracking start on Premium, and kiosk time tracking starts on Business. The security page names no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 report.

facts.text: The free plan covers up to 30 users, but the pricing page lists shift offers there and puts shift swaps and unavailability tracking on Premium and Business.
Sling's security page says all data except passwords and employee IDs is stored without encryption at rest, and it names no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 report.
Timesheets can be exported to Toast Payroll, and the integrations page lists Toast, Square, Harbortouch, Restaurant Manager and POSiTouch as point of sale connections.
The terms say payments are non-refundable and that closing an account in Company Settings is the only valid way to cancel.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; $2.00 on monthly billing. Adds time tracking, labor cost tools and shift swaps

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Billed annually; $4.00 on monthly billing. Adds kiosk time tracking, labor and payroll reports and PTO management

hiddenCosts: The pricing page lists no single sign-on on any plan.

contract.cancellation: Cancel in Company Settings; email or phone requests do not count. No cancellation fee, and payments are non-refundable.
contract.dataExport: The terms describe no export process after an account is closed, and say a closed account cannot be recovered.
